name: Estimate monthly WhatsApp Business API cost per country from an open rate CSV

parameters.content:
## Estimate your monthly WhatsApp Business API cost

### How it works
This workflow helps anyone who budgets WhatsApp Business Platform messaging before launching notifications or campaigns. You list your planned template sends per country and category. The workflow downloads an open rate card (EUR per delivered message, CSV), matches each country to its own rate or its regional rate, and returns the cost per line plus a monthly total with the effective date of the rates.

Meta bills per delivered template message, by recipient country and category (marketing, utility, authentication), and Meta assigns the category. Free-form messages inside the 24 hour customer service window are service messages: 1,000 free per business phone number per month, then billed. Utility templates are billed inside an open window too (since 1 October 2026). Volume tiers lower the price. This estimate uses list rates and does not model the free tier or volume tiers, so it is a ceiling.

### Setup
No credentials needed. Open the "Planned sends (edit me)" node and replace the example lines with your own: country ISO code, category and messages per month. Click Execute workflow and read the output of "Estimate cost". Compare effective_date with Meta's pricing page before you commit to a budget.

### Customization
Read the planned sends from a sheet instead of the Code node, add a Schedule Trigger to rerun it every month, or add a Slack, Gmail or Google Sheets node after "Estimate cost" to deliver the result.

## Plan your sends
Edit the example lines: ISO country code, category and messages per month.

## Price with the open rate card
Downloads the EUR rate CSV once and matches each country to its own or regional rate.
